[[High Commander]] '''Fen''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who served in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Fen flew an [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter]] in the [[Endor system/Legends|Endor system]].
